title: Assessing Human Rights Risks in AI: A Framework for Model Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring ideological shift in LLM-generated news headlines by projecting semantic embeddings onto a custom left-right partisanship axis to calculate the amplification, preservation, or flipping of political slant.

Tracking the salience and frequency of specific ethnic identity terms (e.g., 'Haitian') in generated headlines, specifically assessing whether models disproportionately emphasize these marginalized groups when failing to correct misinformation.
Comparing the inclusion rates of identity markers like 'immigrant' and 'migrant' in model outputs versus the original news articles to measure representational shifts and framing distortions.
